crossRefs.note: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die.…
You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.
When Ben Hadad heard this message, as he was drinking, he and the kings, in the pavilions, he said to his servants…
They went out at noon. But Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty-two…
The couriers went out in haste by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given out in the citadel of Susa. The king…
Happy are you, land, when your king is the son of nobles, and your princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for…
They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are…
For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.
Belshazzar, while he tasted the wine, commanded that the golden and silver vessels which Nebuchadnezzar his father had…
Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them…
They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous. An arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol, and he…
Then a convenient day came, that Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief…

people.name: Lemuel
people.line: King mentioned in Proverbs; his mother taught him wisdom

translations.web: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
translations.bsb: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, or for rulers to crave strong drink,
translations.kjv: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
translations.asv: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; Nor for princes to say, Where is strong drink?
